Three commits of visual/brand work on top of the QC wave already on `main`:

## Rebrand to Compute Marketplace
Light "paper" brand: new name, monogram "C" logo/wordmark, `@theme` tokens (blue primary, warm accent set), Inter/Space Grotesk/JetBrains Mono.

## Adversarial UI/UX/brand audit fixes
A multi-agent audit against a "billion dollar product" bar confirmed 39 findings (0 refuted). Fixed every high and the objective mediums/lows:
- WCAG AA contrast repairs (ink-4, positive/warning/status-delivered tokens)
- Header: opaque on scroll, no double-monogram / wrap on narrow phones
- Money renders in mono everywhere; task types get human display names instead of raw slugs
- Timestamps drop seconds; group IDs show a short code instead of a raw UUID
- Focus-ring / a11y cleanups, page metadata, copy fixes
- Switched the display face to Space Grotesk per brand-guide follow-up

## Surface-depth foundation
The rebrand read as flat "white boxes on white" — no figure/ground, one accent color used only on 2px status dots. This pass:
- Warm off-white canvas with a barely-there dot grid, so white cards read as raised sheets
- Retuned elevation scale (resting / hover / hero) and the fill/fill-2 steps
- `.lift` utility (rise + shadow on hover/focus, reduced-motion safe) applied to interactive cards across both dashboards and the job feed
- StatTile: hairline accent-color top-rule so the money-critical tile stands out from the row

## Test plan
- [x] `tsc --noEmit` clean
- [x] 89/89 integration tests pass against real Postgres
- [x] Production build clean
- [x] Visually verified landing, sign-in, both dashboards, job detail, mobile header at 390px (Playwright screenshots)

body:
Follow-up to #3 (which merged everything through the copy pass). These two commits are on the branch but not yet on `main`.

## `c2e6050` — QC wave 2 fixes
Fixes from a second adversarial QC wave over the elevated UI (40 confirmed findings, 0 refuted). The most important:

- **Tailwind v4 token repair.** The redesign used the v3 `[--var]` bracket shorthand throughout (`rounded-[--radius-field]`, `shadow-[--shadow-elev-1]`, `accent-[--color-brand]`), which Tailwind v4 emits as **invalid CSS** — so the entire token layer was silently dead on `main`: square corners, no shadows, unbranded inputs app-wide. Switched to the `@theme`-generated utilities and verified the built CSS now emits `border-radius:var(--radius-field)`.
- **Nav / state:** `/jobs` tabs now derive from the URL live (AppNav's Feed/Claims links actually switch content); JobDetail no longer hangs on an infinite "Loading job…" on a failed fetch; DemoSignIn redirects to `/dashboard`.
- **Dashboard correctness:** "Charged this month" no longer secretly nets refunds; receipts bounded by charge (not a row limit that cut a charge mid-group); weekly earnings truly net with zero weeks included; held/clearing boundary matches the sweep; "+N more" instead of silent truncation; timestamps render in the viewer's timezone.
- **Components:** Button busy-lock can't be overridden; VendorOnboarding clears its spinner on bfcache restore; cost meter flags out-of-band prices; feed filter debounced; the two legacy pages fully migrated to the token system.

## `48e1a8c` — CI + docs
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: typecheck, the 89-test suite against a `postgres:16` service, and a production build (the gate that would have caught the dead token layer). Closes the last open item from the original quality review.
- README: the demo persona switcher moved into the account menu during the elevation; fixed the stale "top-right role switcher" description.

Verified: typecheck clean, 89/89 tests pass, production build succeeds (token CSS confirmed in output), live Playwright re-check with zero console errors.

CardSetupInner.save() awaited confirmSetup and the finalize fetch with no
error boundary: a network failure after confirmation threw past
setBusy(false), leaving the button permanently disabled on "Saving..."
with no error shown and the rejection unhandled. Wrap the body in
try/catch/finally, mirroring begin(); the finalize call is idempotent
server-side so the retry the new error message asks for is always safe.

uuidtest.tmp.mjs was a leftover debugging probe (its uuid-cast concern is
already handled by isUuid guards and the zod .uuid() batch schema).
